name: us022-dry-run-no-write
description: T022 [US2, S6]: --dry-run on a spec with no prior recorded state must neither read nor write the state document, so a re-run afterwards would still see a full first run. Forward-looking regression guard: no code path writes state for any run yet, so this is trivially green today by omission, not by a proven bypass — the assertion is written now so it fails the moment a future implementation writes state unconditionally on a dry run.
